text:
Chemnitz’s median asking rent sits at 6.1 €/m² in June 2026, up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 15.0 % over the past five years, placing the city at the bottom of the 37‑city price ranking. The market shows a slack balance, with 61 days on market and only 8 % of listings let within a week, while vacancy stands at 9.4 %.

Affordability remains moderate: a 60 m² unit costs 366 €/month, generating a rent‑burden of 8.8 % for two residents. Asking rents sit 16 % above the 2022 census‑based existing rent of 5.26 €/m², reflecting a modest premium.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 6.21 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 6.07 €/m² and 6.41 €/m², implying a modest 1.7 % rise.
